scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT TDOS infeasible; score by relative shift and stability ordering against hidden thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden thresholds for defect state shift and energy ordering
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports a 0.17 eV shift for C_N–O_N states near E_C when d_C-O decreases from 5.18 to 3.17 Å; it states that the C_N–O_N complex is much more stable than C_Ga–O_N.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Thresholds are set generously (shift ≥ 0.1 eV; energy difference > 0.01 eV) to absorb toolchain variations while still requiring the correct physical trends.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds are based on the paper's own reported shift magnitude and logical stability ordering; they are not arbitrary.

outputs.description: Two rows giving the defect-state energy relative to the conduction band for C_N–O_N complexes at ~5.18 Å and ~3.17 Å. The checker applies a hidden threshold to the defect-state energies (for example, comparing the two rows).
Two rows with total energies for C_N-O_N (3.17 Å) and C_Ga-O_N (1.97 Å). The checker applies a hidden threshold to the total energies (for example, comparing the two rows).

output_contract.notes: Scoring is result-level (T0) against hidden paper-derived thresholds. The exact threshold values are not disclosed. The agent must compute both artifacts using a consistent DFT method; toolchain variations are absorbed by the thresholds.

steps.description: Verify that defect state energy shift into gap between the two C_N-O_N complexes is at least 0.1 eV.
Verify that C_N-O_N total energy is lower than C_Ga-O_N by a suitable margin.
